title: Investor-day run-up: long from the second session after the first 8-K announcing an analyst or investor day to the close of the session before it
references: Cabrera, Kolokolova and Zhang (2025) (about 3,061 analyst and investor days, 2011-2022: +3.70% buy-and-hold abnormal return from the announcement to the eve of the event)
hypotheses: LONG only, over decisions 2016-08-01..2026-06-30 with every exit by 2026-07-31, on cohort v3 union cohort xu (2,156 names; config/research/pooled/cohort3-events-v1.json and config/research/pooled/cohort-xu-insider-v1.json, both pinned by SHA-256, with both cached label cubes pinned by content hash and merged with merge_cubes) with the 10:35 New York decision clock, ATR14 and eligibility of the merged cube, the events protocol's pinned Nasdaq calendar archive (market-wide) and both cohorts' pinned corporate-actions acquisitions. Events: the frozen idday-parser-v1 over the pinned SEC 8-K full-text acquisition (content_sha256) gives the pinned event table (events_sha256); F is the first filing that announces the registrant's own investor, analyst or capital markets day or investor/analyst meeting on a future date E (filed < E <= filed + 400 days); event_only events never become legs. Legs: D is the second session strictly after F, X the last session before E, H = sessions from D to X inclusive in [1, 63]; any session it needs outside the merged cube's calendar excludes the event (outside_window); an archive report date in [F + 1, X] excludes it (earnings_in_hold); the class is with_earnings when the issuer has an archive report in the 3-session band ending at F's session, else standalone; one leg per issuer per 63 sessions, applied last among the price-free gates in D order; an identity break on or after D - 60 sessions or a structural corporate action within 5 calendar days of [D, E] excludes it; the cube's eligibility at D must hold; the leg trades the issuer's cohort symbol with the higher dollar volume at D. Trade: decision at 10:35 on D, stop 2.0 x ATR(14) below the decision price, no target and no trail, time exit at the close of X; costs 5, 15 and 25 bp per side, 15 bp decides; a fill not on D or an exit after the close of X is hold_outside_window. Controls: 5 cube cells on D, eligible, in the leg's dollar-volume tercile, not legs on D and not of the leg's issuer, of a visible, uncapped issuer with no fetch failure, with no raw search hit or parsed event in [D - 63, X + 10] sessions, clear of earnings by the leg's class (standalone: no report in [D - 30, X] and at least one report in the 130 sessions before D; with_earnings: a report in the same 3-session band and none in [F + 1, X]), nearest in 20-session return to D - 1; fewer than 5 leaves the leg unpaired. P1: mean net_excess_r_v1 > 0 with the bootstrap ci90 lower bound > 0. P2: mean r_cost(leg) - mean r_cost(controls) over paired legs > 0 with the paired ci90 lower bound > 0, pairs keyed by D. P3: the 1%-trimmed mean of net_excess_r_v1 > 0, its mean over decisions from 2023-01-01 > 0, and P2's statistic has a ci90 lower bound > 0 under an issuer-cluster bootstrap (2000 draws, seed 20261121). P4: at least 250 legs with a finite net_excess_r_v1, at least 60 from 2023-01-01. P5: the legs' paired difference minus the placebos' paired difference > 0 with the ci90 lower bound > 0 from one joint session-block bootstrap. Negative control: one same-symbol pseudo-event per leg with the same H and class, seed 20261122 (with_earnings: another archive report r' within 252 sessions of F, issuer search-hit and event free in [r' - 5, X' + 10], no report in [r' + 1, X']; standalone: a D' within 126 sessions of D, no report in [D' - 30, X'], hit and event free in [D' - 63, X' + 10]); duplicates dropped; its P2 must not hold and P5 must hold. Planted effect: every paired placebo leg gets 0.0185 of the decision price in R in r_cost and net_excess_r_v1, and P1 and P2 on that frame must both hold. Parser check: 60 candidate legs (seed 20261119) of issuers outside the 50-name feasibility sample, labelled by hand, at most 9 errors, pinned by sha256 before any price read. Stationary session-block bootstrap over decision sessions, block mean 10, 2000 draws, seed 20261120; ci90 = [5th, 95th] percentiles. See docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-19-apriori-idday-design.md.
decision_rule: This is a development read on today's survivors with a hand-checked parser: it can only return survives_development, failed or inconclusive_underpowered, and none of them authorizes a probe, a card, promotion, shadow or registry credit. inconclusive_underpowered if the planted check fails; else failed if any of P1-P5 fails or the placebo's P2 holds; else survives_development, which only makes a separately specified prospective step eligible (a live 8-K capture feeding unvalidated paper cards, or a prospective read; the operator chooses). No parser rule, threshold, lead, stop, cost, window or control parameter is revisited after the run; any change is a new version. The class, year, cohort-band, keyword, hold and liquidity splits and every other diagnostic are descriptive and decide nothing.
